subject.title: fix(tlon): bound stalled inbound and outbound media header waits

question: Should Tlon adopt a 120-second response-header deadline for both inbound media retrieval and outbound URL-backed image upload?
rationale: The mechanism and proof are strong, but choosing two minutes is an intentional compatibility policy: unusually slow yet valid servers will newly fail into existing fallback behavior.

options.title: Accept 120 seconds
options.body: Adopt the shared two-minute header deadline for both directions, matching the established Telegram policy and supplied runtime proof.

options.title: Choose a longer deadline
options.body: Keep the shared header-only mechanism but retune the constant to a Tlon-specific duration and refresh the stalled-header proof.

options.title: Preserve unbounded waits
options.body: Decline the timeout behavior change if known Tlon deployments require arbitrarily long response-header waits.

recommendation.title: Accept 120 seconds
recommendation.body: Adopt the shared two-minute header deadline for both directions, matching the established Telegram policy and supplied runtime proof.
